column1: # title: Mass balance of the Greenland and Antarctic Ice Sheets from the 1970s to 2023
# summary: This dataset contains rates and cumulative anomalies in surface mass balance
column3: and total mass change and their associated uncertainty for the Antarctic Ice Sheet (in its entirety and split into West Antarctica
column4: East Antarctica and the Antarctic Peninsula) for the period 1979 to 2023 and for the Greenland Ice Sheet for the period 1972 to 2023. The data are reconciled estimates of mass balance from three independent satellite-based techniques: altimetry
column6: and the input-output method. This dataset is part of the Ice Sheet Mass Balance Intercomparison Exercise (IMBIE).

column1: # history: The data used to produce this reconciled mass balance estimate were gathered in the framework of the IMBIE project. In total
column2: 45 independent satellite estimates of mass change (21 estimates for Antarctica and 24 estimates for Greenland) were used to produce this final dataset. The methodology to aggregate these into a final estimate is described in Otosaka et al. (2026).

column1: # comment: The data are reconciled estimates from 45 individual satellite-based surveys derived from the altimetry
column2: gravimetry and input-output techniques. The respective one sigma uncertainties for each reconciled dataset are provided.
